external_anchor_in_vacuo_plate.limit: eq.(3) with k -> infinity; error is O(rho_w / (rho_i h k))
external_anchor_in_vacuo_plate.reference: Euler-Bernoulli in-vacuo plate: omega^2 = D k^4 / (rho_i h) (Timoshenko & Woinowsky-Krieger, Theory of Plates and Shells, 2nd ed., 1959)

shared_core_regression.note: hydroelastic now delegates to flexural_gravity; this is a regression pin on the shared core, not an independent check

E1_dispersion_solver.description: numerical omega(k) (wavenumber solver round-trip) vs closed form, rel <= 1%

E1b_independent_model.description: closed-form eq.(3) vs finite-difference depth solve (psi''=k^2 psi, Neumann bottom, ice/water free-surface condition)
E1b_independent_model.subject: tensorbem.flexural_gravity.flexural_gravity_omega2_mass_loading

E2_long_wave_limit.description: k->0: omega^2 -> g k tanh(kH), rel <= 0.5%

E3_short_wave_limit.description: k->inf (deep water): omega^2 -> D k^5 / rho_w, rel <= 0.5%

E4_energy_conservation.description: |R|^2+|T|^2-1 residual <= 1e-4 over 8 frequencies x 3 thicknesses x 2 models

E5_wavelength_behavior.crossover_note: above the crossover wavenumber (bending dominated) the ice wave is faster; see deep_water_crossover_wavenumber
E5_wavelength_behavior.description: eq.(3) inertia-dominated long waves: lambda_ice < lambda_open

E7_zero_rigidity.description: D=0 negative control: open-water dispersion, rel <= 1e-6

E8_parameter_sensitivity.description: lambda increases monotonically with h_ice (>=4 thicknesses), eq.2 and eq.3
